name: Tags
description: Obsidian-style #tags: highlighted in the editor, suggested as you type, listed in a sidebar panel and renamable across the folder.

panel.title: Tags
panel.noFolder: Open a folder to see its tags.
panel.empty: No tags yet. Type # followed by a word in a note.
panel.noNotes: No note uses this tag anymore.

rename.title: Rename tag
rename.invalidTo: Use letters, digits, _, - or / (for nesting), with at least one letter.
rename.same: The new name is the same as the current one.
rename.tabNote: Notes open in a tab are changed in the tab and stay unsaved until you save them.
rename.conflicts: Changed on disk after the preview, not renamed: {files}. Run the rename again to include them.
